title: v2.1.0: Settings, Font Size & Polish
body: You can now set your preferred lyrics font size directly in Settings, so every song opens at the size you like. Loading screens now match each page's real layout for a smoother experience. The About section also now credits Isus Christos Ministries (ICM), whose blessing made this app possible.

title: Jungli Darkhton Ke Darmiyan Added
body: Added Hindi/Hinglish lyrics for Jungli Darkhton Ke Darmiyan from the reviewed screenshots, so it is now available in the library, setlists, and Present Mode.

body: Added and cleaned Hindi/Hinglish lyrics for Itna Kareeb Aa, Jai Jai Prabhu Yeshu Ki, Janma hai Emmanuel, Jee Utha Hai Masiha, and Jo Kuchh Wo Tum Se Kahe.

body: Added and cleaned Hindi/Hinglish lyrics for 12 worship songs, including Ek Aisi Agni, Ek Do Teen Char, Hai Tu, Ho Sitaish, Ho Teri Aradhana, and Hungama.

title: Setlists, Better Search & Smoother Navigation
body: Added setlists for worship planning, next and previous controls in Present Mode, lyrics-aware search with fuzzy matching, clearer empty states, visible favourite and setlist buttons, smoother tab switching, offline/update notices, and a more balanced floating navigation bar.

title: Bug Fixes & Long-Press to Favourite
body: Hold any song on the home screen to instantly save it to favourites, no need to open the song. Also fixed skeleton loading screens, corrected swipe behaviour on recently viewed, and songs now appear in Recently Viewed after you visit them.

title: 11 New Songs Added
body: Added new worship songs from Nations of Worship, Sheldon Bangera, and Immanuel Community Church.
song_names: Phir Se Vo Aag Barsa De
Uski Mahima Karo, Bandhan Toot Jaayenge

title: Missing Artists Recovered
body: Added accurate artist and church information mapping to 189 existing songs in the database. You can now properly browse and search these songs by their artists.

title: Improved Hindi Lyrics
body: All Hindi song lyrics have been re-transliterated for better accuracy. Fixed edge cases in transliteration so the text reads more naturally.

title: Refreshed Icons & Visuals
body: All icons across the app have been upgraded to a cleaner, more consistent design. The Vandana wordmark has also been improved.

title: Mobile Layout Fixes
body: Fixed church filter overflow, search icon alignment, and empty state sizing on smaller screens for a smoother mobile experience.

title: New Feature: Favourites
body: You can now save your favourite songs and access them instantly.

title: 100 Songs Added
body: We've added 100 new worship songs from ICM, Nations of Worship, Sheldon Bangera and more.
